meta.note: Conversions must compound intelligence, not just produce outputs.

law: Every approved conversion makes the system smarter. Learning is the product; the artifact is the byproduct.

mechanics.desc: Each approved conversion writes a learning holding to the Archive: the deliberation, the convergence, the approval, the participating agents. Learnings are first-class holdings against the 15MB budget.

Participating agents gain XP in the Raijin skill pattern (Harvesting/Weaving/Arcana extended to all agents by role), plus a quanta boost and a positive drift delta. Successful deliberation visibly raises an agent's coherence.

Agents may propose INTELLIGENCE upgrades as a conversion type: refined routing, new deliberation patterns, new capabilities, corrected mappings. PROPOSAL_ONLY until Nathan approves — same gate as builds and syntheses.
Track system intelligence over time: mean agent quanta + skill XP totals, shown in the Agents drawer. An upward slope = the system getting smarter. Flat = heat-death guard territory.
